notes_for_editor: Standing status rests on the March 2014 list and Tennessee Landforms; nothing after 2014 confirms it. Unresolved: the May 2023 Abandoned Online post has a title that names a Pilot Knob tower and ends in Abandoned, but gives no county, so it was not used to change the status. The directory name Dale Hollow Fire Tower is undated and unsourced, so it is not used as the tower's name. Name collision: the Pilot Knob tower in Cumberland County (tnlandforms 4-7, 2021 ft, standing; on the 2014 list) is a different tower. The record's NGS register entry (GB 2367) appears on the towers page only as a code in the Info column, so the register label is unverified. The gate and walk come from a 1999 trip report; current access is unknown. The NHLR Tennessee list read on 2026-10-09 does not name Pilot Knob.
